base.description: cute friendly chibi penguin mascot standing and facing the viewer, front view, wearing a dark teal hoodie with the hood down and small headphones around the neck, big shiny eyes, orange beak and feet, white belly, one flipper raised in a friendly greeting, full body, centered, pixel art game character

processing: Alpha cut at 128, the generated grey ground shadow under the feet removed, the first eight frames of each animation, the first sixteen for the walk cycles and dances (or the listed picked frames), cropped to their shared bounds and packed side by side as looping sprite sheets. The calm sheet holds the first idle frame and blinks once. The Scuba dance starts and ends on its own pose: one flipper over the beak (edited from the base with the hood and neck headphones kept) and the other flipper inpainted to point forward at the viewer.

animation.action: the penguin stands in place breathing gently, the body bobs slightly up and down and the eyes blink once, the flippers stay in the same pose, same size and position, seamless loop
the penguin talks happily: the beak opens and closes as if speaking, the head tilts a little and the flippers make small friendly gestures, same size and position, seamless loop
the penguin waves hello with its right flipper raised high, waving side to side twice, smiling, the rest of the body stays in place, seamless loop

the penguin walks toward the viewer in place with a smooth waddle walk cycle: the orange feet step one after the other, two full steps with each foot, the body rocks side to side and bobs, the flippers swing gently, very smooth and fluid, seamless walk loop, stays in the same position

the penguin walks to the right in place with a cute smooth waddle walk cycle: the orange feet step forward one after the other, two full steps with each foot, the body rocks slightly and bobs up and down, the flippers swing gently, very smooth and fluid, seamless walk loop, stays in the same position

the penguin walks away from the viewer in place with a smooth waddle walk cycle seen from behind: the orange feet step one after the other, two full steps with each foot, the body rocks side to side and bobs, the flippers swing gently, very smooth and fluid, seamless walk loop, stays in the same position
the penguin stands in place breathing gently, the body bobs slightly up and down and the eyes blink once, the flippers stay in the same pose, same size and position, seamless loop

scuba dance in place: the penguin slowly sways its upper body and head left and right once, bobbing down slightly on its knees at each side, feet planted. The flipper on the beak stays on the beak. The other flipper keeps pointing forward at the viewer and its tip wiggles quickly left and right like a fish fin, four times. Hood and neck headphones unchanged, same size and position, very smooth seamless loop

pose.description: Same cute penguin, identical look: teal hood up over the head, small grey headphones around the neck, same face, colours, size and feet. Change only the flippers: the flipper on the left side of the image covers the beak like holding breath before a dive. The other flipper points straight forward in front of the chest, flat like a fish fin. Exactly two flippers. Full body visible.

pose.mask: the free flipper, x 30 to 50 and y 30 to 50
pose.description: the penguin flipper on the right side is stretched straight forward toward the viewer at chest height, seen edge-on like a pointing flat hand, the dark flipper tip points at the camera, the other flipper still covers the beak, same white belly, colours and dark outline
